patterns.name: Floating header
patterns.description: A framed bar, not a full-width strip: 1204px wide, inset 16px from the top (--navbar-container-padding-top), 76px tall at 1440 and 58px (--navbar-height) at 390, corner about 12px (pixel trace, not computed), 1px light edge with a brighter top line, fill about #0f1011. Logo at the left, nine 14px/500 #9c9c9d links grouped centre-right, then a text log-in link and the light Download button (36px) at the right edge. At 390 the links collapse to a hamburger; the mobile panel transitions height and transform 0.3s ease.

patterns.name: Centred hero
patterns.description: Everything centred. Home: two-line 64px/600 headline, a two-line 18px white subtitle, a long empty gap, then the light button with an Apple glyph, a 12px mono requirement line and two mono text buttons separated by a bar. The download block is not shown at 390. Store, pro and teams heroes add an abstract image (blurred diagonal ribbons, an icon cloud, or an orbit of avatars) behind the headline.

patterns.name: Two-tone section intro
patterns.description: A 20px/500 heading in #ffffff followed directly by its continuation in #6a6b6c at the same size and weight, no gap, either centred above a full-width mockup or left-aligned in a narrow column. This replaces separate title and subtitle sizes.

patterns.name: Product window as hero image
patterns.description: A 1204px framed desktop (1184px inner image, 720px tall) containing a full-size launcher window: a macOS menu bar, the command palette with list and detail panes, an action bar and a dock of square tool buttons. Captions sit centred below in the two-tone style.

patterns.name: Extension carousel
patterns.description: Header row with a two-tone intro at the left and a pill tab group at the right. Cards are 360x536px with 56px between them, overflow the container to the right and end with a browse-more card. Below: an arrow text link at the left and two 58x57px round arrow buttons at the right.

patterns.name: Bento of mockups
patterns.description: One full-width card (AI chat window) above two half-width cards (inline prompt, extensions). Each card is mostly mockup with a 16px/500 title and a #9c9c9d description pinned to the bottom-left. Cards are 1px-ringed dark panels; the stack becomes single-column at 390.

patterns.name: Ruled grid
patterns.description: Developer section and feature grids use cells that share 1px rings (cell-ring shadow) with 24px padding and 32px internal gap; hovering a cell fills it with #0c0d0f in 0.15s.

patterns.name: Store grid
patterns.description: 1140px column. Featured: three 359x364px cards with 32px gaps, icon tile centred on top. Listing: a toolbar row (pill tabs left, platform chips and a 320px search right), then two columns of 558x186px cards with 24px gaps, then numbered pagination centred.

patterns.name: Plan cards
patterns.description: Three cards side by side; the middle (recommended) card is taller and raised above its neighbours, with a lighter fill. Each card: name, one-line description, an optional tier segmented control, a large price with a mono unit and a mono billed-annually line with a struck-through price, a full-width button, then a checklist with circled check icons and grey sub-lines. A Monthly / Yearly pill toggle with a mono discount chip sits above the cards. Card radius, fill and the raise offset were not isolated by the measurement.

patterns.name: Comparison table
patterns.description: Full 1204px width, a wide first column of feature labels (white label, grey sub-list), five plan columns with centred white check marks or a small grey dot for absent features, 1px vertical rules, a thicker band between groups, and a row of light buttons at the bottom.

patterns.name: FAQ list
patterns.description: Centred 700px column under a two-tone heading. Each row is a 102px button (39px vertical padding) with a 16px/600 white question and a chevron at the right, separated by faint 1px rules.

patterns.name: Footer
patterns.description: Six link columns (14px/500 #9c9c9d, external links followed by a small up-right arrow), then a 1px rule, then a newsletter band: text block at the left, a 430px form at the right (field, submit, 12px legal text).

layout.responsive: At 390 the header keeps its framed shape (16px inset, 58px tall) with logo and hamburger; the hero headline drops to 36px and body to 14px, the hero download block disappears, the two-tone headings drop to 18px, and every bento or grid collapses to one column with mockups scaled down inside their cards. Carousels keep horizontal overflow with the round arrows beside the arrow link. At 768 the type sizes stay as at 1440 (h1 64px).

unmeasured: --spring-1 is a CSS linear() spring easing on :root, but the capture truncated its value after the first points ("linear(0 0%, .005927 1%, .022466 2%, ..."), so the curve is not reproduced here and no element using it was identified.
Running durations of the dialog, tooltip, shake, icon-success and most entrance keyframes: they are in the served CSS but were not running when measured.

Hover states that are script-driven did not register under forced hover: the home nav link and light button showed no hover difference on home while the same controls did on pricing; announcement pills and showcase cards showed none.
The hero keyboard plays a scripted typing sequence (keys lighting and scaling with the keycap transition). Sequence and timing are script-driven and only partly visible as running transitions.
Extension card illustrations (status rings, scrolling translations, a media player) and the command palette mockup animate by script; not specified.
Teams and pro heroes use WebGL or large images with blurred ribbons; the moving parts are not specified.
FAQ open state, the plan tooltip and their entrance motion: the captures after the models dialog were taken with that dialog still open.
Mobile nav panel contents and its open state were not captured.
Header collapse to the menu button happens between 870px and 880px wide; the exact breakpoint was not observed.
Store sort pill, category accordion, blog filters and changelog platform switch: hover and open transitions were not observed.
Careers timeline, hiring steps and sign-up highlight carousel are script-driven; their timing was not observed.

Right: a 430px form, the 276x42px field and 138x42px soft light submit on one row 16px apart, and a three-line 12px/400 #ffffff66 consent paragraph with an inline privacy link below.

screen: Title and short description at the left

steps.validation: The field is type text, so the browser shows no native bubble. Submitting it empty showed a custom message ("Email Address is invalid") in red #ff6363 monospace above the field, and the field border turned red; the page stayed. The field's module ships a 3px shake keyframe; whether it ran was not recorded. Recorded on home, pricing, store and pro; no validation was recorded on teams.

flows.notRecorded: The success state after a valid address and any confirmation email: recording them would subscribe a real address. Log in and sign up live at /users/sign_in and /users/sign_up (see their flows); /login returns 404.

principles: Paint every page on #07080a. Separate surfaces with 1px light rings, inner top highlights (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05 to 0.15) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset) and #0c0d0f to #1b1c1e fills, not with drop shadows.
Centre the hero and most section intros. Write section intros as one 20px/500 sentence in #ffffff followed by its continuation in #6a6b6c at the same size.
Use the product itself as the imagery: full macOS-style windows (command palette, AI chat, notes), keycaps and docks, built from the same tokens, larger than the text column.

Make the main button feel like a lit key: #e6e6e6 fill, #2f3031 label, 8px radius, a dark 2px ring, a soft white halo and inner highlights. It turns #ffffff on hover. Use the dark ringed button for everything secondary.
Keep text grey by default. Links and tabs rest at #9c9c9d or #6a6b6c and turn #ffffff on hover in 0.3s ease. Card hovers are fills (#0c0d0f) in 0.15s.

Interface text is 14px/500 with 0.2px tracking in Inter with ss03. Put small facts in 12px mono: requirements, price notes and table headers. Section eyebrows are short uppercase red mono labels (seen in screenshots; size not measured).
Red #ff6363 is the brand mark and the eyebrow colour; blue #56c2ff marks included features. Neither ever fills a button.
Show shortcuts as keycaps (command K in search fields, return and command K in action bars), so the site reads as keyboard-first.
avoid: Coloured or gradient primary buttons; the primary is always the light grey key
Light page sections or white cards
Generic stock illustrations instead of product UI
Large drop shadows on cards resting on the canvas
Left-aligned marketing heroes with side images
Separate subtitle sizes under section headings instead of the two-tone continuation
Bright borders: card edges stay at #ffffff0f to #ffffff40
